faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

faqs.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
faqs.a: No. The Catechist Free plan is free forever. Just create your account.

faqs.q: Is the AI really useful for preparing meetings?
faqs.a: Yes. It was trained on the CNBB Bible, the Catechism and the Directory for Catechesis. It generates complete scripts with objective, activity, reading, reflection, activity and prayer — in seconds.
Perfectly. Take attendance, prepare meetings and communicate with families right from your mobile browser, no installation needed.

faqs.q: Can I import catechumens from my spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes. Upload your CSV with name, surname and birth date. Import is instant.
Yes. The platform follows data protection laws. Consents are digitally recorded and you can request data export or deletion at any time.

faqs.q: Can I have multiple classes or parishes?
faqs.a: Yes. The Parish plan allows multiple classes and catechists. The Diocese plan manages multiple parishes with consolidated analytics.
